Market today: The market's mood is mixed. US tech saw a rebound, but Asia isn't following, suggesting global caution. Lower Treasury yields are a tailwind for your growth-heavy book, but the US ban on DeepSeek highlights ongoing AI/China tensions, which could impact chip names.

Your holdings: Your leveraged chip ETF, SOXL, is down a painful 56.11% and needs immediate attention. MUU, another leveraged play, is also down 30.63%. SMCI, a core chip name, is off 26.85%. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep an eye on Treasury yields; continued drops could support tech. Also, monitor global tech sentiment, especially given the mixed US/Asia signals.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your deeply negative leveraged positions and respecting your stops to protect capital.
plays: Your SOXL stop at 200 is far from its current 98.65. Given the 56.11% loss and leveraged nature, review and adjust this stop to protect capital.
SMH is marked 'TRIM' and trading near its 540 stop. Consider trimming if it breaks this level to reduce exposure.
MUU is down 30.63% and leveraged. Review its stop at 31.6; consider tightening it to limit further downside.
